Partition of: measurements FOR VALUES FROM ('2024-01-01') TO ('2025-01-01')
Partition constraint: ((logdate IS NOT NULL) AND (logdate >= '2024-01-01'::date) AND (logdate < '2025-01-01'::date))
Indexes:
